profile.summary: Prismx Global Ventures Limited trades in commodities, shares, and securities. It operates through three segments: Commodity trading Business, Finance Business Activities, and Information Technology. The company also offers digital media, financial investment, and consultancy services. The company was formerly known as Gromo Trade & Consultancy Limited and changed its name to Prismx Global Ventures
